name: Monotone Causal Authority & Admissibility Types
core_laws: salience/candidate/internal values cannot implicitly upcast to authoritative fact
model output may construct EffectIntent but cannot construct EffectPermit
direct irreversible destructive maintenance is outside model-authored ClayCode authority
model-visible local mutation should prefer append/version/quarantine/recoverable activation
recoverability != harmlessness; effect-time semantic validation remains mandatory
collection semantics remain first-class from TCQS
physical lowering identity is receipted but excluded from semantic identity

authority.EffectPermit: opaque host-minted capability; never generated by model or serialized into model text

destruction_refinement.strong_hypothesis_refuted: absence of destructive verbs alone prevents damage
destruction_refinement.retained_hypothesis: absence of destructive model primitives hard-limits direct irreversible mutation when the host exposes no equivalent ambient capability

promotion_blockers: no real syscall/capability sandbox adversarial test
no real FRANK workload coverage test
external capability broker correctness remains security-critical
